definitions.explanation: Movement or position in the vertical direction; upward and downward.

definitions.gloss: high and low, superior and inferior
definitions.explanation: Social hierarchy or ranking; differences in status or position.
When a book is published in two parts (upper and lower volumes).

notes:
{上下|じょうげ} expresses vertical relationships, whether physical (up/down movement) or social (hierarchy).

PRONUNCIATION:
- じょうげ: standard reading for up/down, hierarchy
- うえ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: less common, more casual reading

COMPOUNDS:
- {上下|じょうげ}⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: hierarchical relationship
- {上下|じょうげ}⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧: up-and-down motion
- {上下|じょうげ}⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧: up, down, left, right (all directions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{左右|さゆう}→左右：02826_sayuu⟧: left and right (horizontal)
- ⟦{前後|ぜんご}→前後：04042_zengo⟧: front and back
